pylons_vi: 2 tháp hình cây đước (chân rễ choãi), cao ≈100 m
pylons_en: 2 mangrove-tree pylons with splayed root legs, ≈100 m

model3d.notes: 350 m span (2019 approval). The design changed from one 230 m pylon to two 'mangrove' (cây đước) pylons ≈100 m (press). Side spans and deck width (6 lanes) estimated. Pylon shape per Tuổi Trẻ render (1/2026).

pylon_custom.description: Current two-pylon 'mangrove tree' (cây đước) design per the 1/2026 render: each pylon has two splayed 'root' legs that rise from the water outside the deck, curve inward under/through the deck and join into one trunk about a third of the way up; the trunk continues as a single mast carrying fan stays in two planes.

review: Kept; render confirms root legs splitting from one trunk
